notes.title: The Community Expansion, Monk, New Allies & Perks, New mechanics and more!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Today's patch is pretty big, and aside from the usual bugfixes, QoL additions and of course new Content, it also introduces the "Community Expansion". The Community Expansion is optional and can be safely deactivated through your ModManager. 

Its contents will be creations from our modding community and will be included in the base game for convenience and better integration. And of course with the respective author's permission.

The community Expansion pack currently includes the Monk class, 2 new Expertises and over 110+ cards, and was created by Ashthh (Gurrflumfr).

Other highlights of this latest patch, include several new Galdorak and Fay allies which you can find among the local population of various Towns in the sandbox mode, an infusion system, to bring a fresh life to your consumable items, new perks for high level adventurers and more!

You can read more details in the patch notes below!

 21/10 # 1.024.0

 Bugfixes 

 Aura of Light or Darkness will now be taken into account before setting the Enemy intent to "Will die".
 Fixed an issue with Starting collection cards in Starter Deck not counting while determining the max card copies allowed while opening the constructed boosters.
 Fixed an issue with MaxDeckCopies property applying after opening the constructed boosters.
 Fixed an issue with reaching negative summon limit after character creation allowing to summon allies.
 Fixed an issue with perks gained after character creation allowing the summon limit to drop below 0.
 Fixed some minor issues in a couple of Monk cards.
 Ulniir Skald was missing his "Miniature" property.
 Mentoring a Card that was matching a Keyword name, would instead of the Card produce the Keyword. (i.e Mentoring the card called 'Loyalty' would instead produce the 'Loyalty' effect).
 Clockwork enemies were incorrectly counting as Living.
 Fixed a couple of typos.


 Introducing Community Expansion 

The Community Expansion is optional and can be safely deactivated through your ModManager. Its content was created by our modding community and is included in the base game for convience and better integration and of course with the respective author's permission.

The community Expansion pack currently includes the Monk class, 2 new Expertises and over 110+ cards.


 Added a new playable class: Monk and their assorted cards. (Special thanks to: Ashthh (Gurrflumfr) who designed the class)
 Monk has the Harmonic Fist, Dissonant Fist, Silent Fist & Wild Lotus subclasses and is aimed for experienced players.
 Added new Expertises: Martial Arts & Harmony


 New Content 

 Added new Fay Allies and their assorted cards: They'll appear for Fay characters or in Settlements with Fay, Seelie or Unseelie Population.
 Added new Galdorak Allies: They'll appear in Settlements with Galdorak Population.
 Added a new repeatable event 'Serendipity?', that can randomly lead to various helpful or harmful outcomes.
 Added a new perk tree "Traveler" with 8 new perks for Sandbox modes that make use of the new perk properties (see below) and will affect overworld travel, random encounters, outdoor activities etc.
 Added a Starting Kit with Spells for the Shadow Mage.


 New Mechanic: Infused 

Infused can be added in any consumable item (with uses, charges or durability) to prevent it getting consumed once it runs out of uses/charges/durability.


 syntax -> Infused:1
 You can use an Infused card only as long as it has at least 1 Use, Charge or Durability remaining.
 Infused cards remain in your possession but are unusable till you refill, recharge or repair them.
 Note to modders: All cards of the same name are technically instances of the same card. ie. share uses count. As such, is highly recommended when using Infused:1 in cards to also make them Singleton:1.
 Infused items with fully depleted Uses, Charges or Durability can be recharged (while out of Combat) from the Player's Collection by spending 'Essence' cards. The backpack icon changes to the 'Essence' icon when refilling an item is possible.
 You can't refill partially depleted items, but only once they reach 0 uses.
 The cost to refill an item is the minimum of 1 and Item Tier + 1 ie. Tier -1 & Tier 0 items will cost 1 Essence, while a Tier 3 item will cost 4 Essence.
 Added a button in Town to purchase 'Essence' cards. The PC can carry up to 12 Essence cards, and they cost 75 Farthing to purchase.


 New Keyword: Infuse

Infuse x: Restore (up to) x Uses, Charges or Durability in all 'Infused' cards in your hand.


 syntax -> Infuse:x
 Note to modders: The intended method of recharging items is out of combat, in Player's Collection by spending 'Essence'. Infuse effect, at least in vanilla cards will be quite costly, extremely rare and limited to certain archetypes.


 New Keyword: Hoard 

 syntax -> Hoard:x

 Create (up to) x permanent copies in your Stash (or Inventory)

 compound syntax -> HoardCard[Card Name]:x

 Create (up to) x permanent copies of 'Card Name' in your Stash (or Inventory).

 Notes to modders about Hoard:

 'Up to' in both versions refers to the max copies the player is allowed to have. ie. if you can have 2 Copies of a card, then you can Stash up to 2 copies with Hoard.
 Single use cards with Hoard, can only be played from your Hand and not from your Collection. If they are in your Collection, then they are already home.



 Misc Changes & QoL 

 Shapeshift cards will display "Shapeshift to chosen form." while uncommitted to a form (ie. inspecting them in the character creation).
 Improved Draft event to support multiple Deck requirements (supports up to 55 picks).
 In Game Mode Editor: Separated the "Collector" option from the Sandbox settings. Added a new separate option for specifying how you'll construct your Deck. This includes Starting Collection, Collection + 36 Cards, Collection + 48 Cards, 36 cards, 48 cards, 60 cards or Draft and can apply to either Sandbox or Gauntlet modes.
 Witches who lost their familiar can now purchase the 'Find Familiar' card in Towns. Or infuse the 'Find Familiar' card if they still have it.
 Increased the amount of energy restored while resting in the Inn and in PC own properties. (to counteract traveling fatigue).
 Changed the Organization tab graphics to be more compact.
 Increased the width of the scrollbar in the Deckbuilder for more comfortable browsing.
 Added Infused & Infuse entries in the Rulebook.
 Updated several consumable cards and items to use the new 'Infused' mechanic. (You can look them up in Player's Handbook by searching for Infused=1). 
 In the compass options: Added a confirmation question when clicking to abandon the area, in case it was by accident.
 Added sprite icons for Stances and updated the Rulebook entry on Stances to include their icons.
 In Mod Manager: Hovering over the official content / expansions, will give additional details on what they include.
 Allies that are still 'Active' when they start their turn, they'll either Heal (like before, if they are hurt) OR gain +3 XP (if they are already in full health).
 In Book of Heroes: Character details will show the Subspecies/Specialization (if one is available) instead of Species/Class.


 Other Modding Additions 

 While defining Background & Starting Kits you can use Exclude:archetype, to exclude that archetype and keep everyone else.
 In Events Min Deck can be used a check MinDeck:x-y where x,y are the limits the deck must be within. ie. Draft 24 Cards@IF: MinDeck:20-24, choice is available if the Deck Min falls between 20 & 24 cards.
 The following Perk effects will affect various Overworld travel mechanics:

 ModifyEffectOverlandSafeHours:x,  Normally the player can have encounters every 12 hours, this increases or reduces that threshold by x when traveling by land.
 ModifyEffectOverlandCamping:x, You recover x times more energy per hours of rest (to counteract traveling fatigue).
 ModifyEffectOverlandConvertEncounterToEvent:x, You get an x% chance that instead of a random Encounter the PC will get a random event. 

 Normally, there is 0% chance to get Event instead of Encounter while in the overworld map.
 If you do get an event with this method, there is an 2x% chance that it'll be the "Serendipity?" event.

 ModifyEffectSeaVoyageEncPenalty:x, Normally the sea voyage has a 5% extra chance than over land travel for encounters, this property will reduce or increase this rate by x.
 ModifyEffectSeaVoyageSafeHours:x,  Normally the player can have encounters every 12 hours, this increases or reduces that threshold by x when traveling by sea.
 ModifyEffectSeaVoyageAP:x, Restores x AP per hour traveled by sea.
 ModifyEffectSeaVoyageHP:x, Restores x HP per hour traveled by sea.

notes.title: Hags, Ulniir Tribes, Hyanars, Pariah Mode and an Improved Game Mode editor
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Halloween is just around the corner, so what a better time for Hag to make her appearance? 

Aside from the Hag species, this patch also includes the Hyanar subspecies, new Ulniir perks, a new game mode and an Improved Game Mode editor to design with more ease your own custom modes.

You can read more details in the patch notes below:

 Patch Notes - 15/10 # 1.023.4 

 Bugfixes 

 Fixed an issue with Damage preview algorithm estimating that a card damage <= 0 will deal damage if the enemy has vulnerable.
  Fixed an issue with Control + Weaken prediction not taking into account the Enemy Immunity against Weaken
 Expertise based Primal perk benefits wasn't displaying properly in the Card (They were still applying correctly)
 Fusion wasn't counting properly the casting card as an ingredient if the card wasn't in the PC's hand while casted (ie. was used by dragging it on an Enemy etc.)


 New Content 

 Added new cards.
 Added new playable subspecies Hyanar (Ulniir) and their assorted cards.
 Added new Tribe Perks and Cards for the various Ulniir subspecies.
 Added a new playable species: Hag and their assorted cards. Hag has the Night Hag, Forest Hag and Beldame subspecies.
 Added new background Librarian.
 Added a Bludgeoning Weapon Kit for the Mercenaries
 Added 6 "Epic" Perks for high to epic level characters. These perks are only available in the Sandbox modes.
 Added New Mode 'Pariah'. Pariah uses the similar rules with 'Campaign'	minus the "Doomsday Clock" plus the following extra rules: All settlements will initially deny you entry till your Influence in that area improves to a +2 Modifier. (Can't enter any Towns before reaching Influence 2). Towns can sell cards up to Expertise 5. (Regardless of their Tier Towns can never sell non-Commodity cards that require more than Expertise 5)


 Misc Changes & QoL 

 Tier -1 cards (that can't be upgraded) won't show up any gems to visually separate from T0 cards (which can have 1 upgrade).
 In Card Codex entries: Added a tag if the card can be gained through a certain perk (or perks).
 Special Tags will also display when you click a card in the Player's Handbook or through a Hyperlink and not just when it's Alt + Clicked.
 In Character Sheet: You can click the 'Effect Modifiers' key to view them in the Codex (ie. if the tooltip no longer fit in the screen view).
 Lowered the price of the Misthold animal pen upgrade and of each livestock you can get there.
 Set the Nature Magic requirement of Wild Boar to *, he can now only be created by other cards. (Excluded from Loot tables)
 Tweaked the algorithms generating Constructed mode boosters, to minimize Consumable & Equipment drops.
 In Deckbuilder the collection count tooltip will now also break down the collection counts of Action, Consumables & Equipment.


 Revamped the Custom Mode Editor 

 Renamed various fields to make their purpose clearer.
 Added separated options for Sandbox and Gauntlet modes.
 Added new options and removed some legacy settings that require modding knowledge to use properly and could cause confusion.


 New Game Mode properties 

 "Pariah":bool, Locks all settlements till the player reaches an influence modifier of +2 (+175 influence)
 "MerchantsSellUpToExpertise":int, Restricts the merchandise merchants can sell normal cards up to expertise x (this setting overrides any town upgrades, but doesn't affect commodities, imports & exports.)

notes.title: Hotfix - 12/10 # 1.023.1a
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This hotfix basically fixes an issue with the Quick Cast button not working properly with non-card abilities. 

The excessive download size is because it caught me preparing the next content update.

It probably seems unimportant, but is one of the hotfixes that can't really wait, as it can cause an exception error, which can then affect many other game systems in a chaotic domino reaction.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 11/10 # 1.023.1
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Along with the fixes for the reported bugs, today's update also includes some important balance changes to make certain underutilized effects more viable options for mid-high level characters. 

It's mostly buffs, but you should probably read the details in the patch notes below, as there also some changes in the enemy 'Healing' & 'Renegerate' tactics too.

There are also several new cards, allies, and a couple more challenges and enemies for the areas introduced in the previous patch.

 11/10 # 1.023.1 

 Bugfixes 

 Expertise perk benefits in Expend Buff weren't working properly ie. 'Ancient Blood' perk.
 Fixed certain random encounters in the overworld map ie. while foraging, hunting etc. not scaling up to the player's level.
 The 'x' button in Town was opening the main menu instead of closing the Town UI.
 Moved Custom Artwork cache UI elements below those of Steam Uploader as they could overlap if both were open.
 Commodities already in Player's stash were showing up as always available for purchase in Towns.
 Commodities with a type different from their name weren't properly counting as Exports/Imports.
 Commodities with preset prices (through the BuyingCost keyword) will now properly receive price adjustments from being Exports/Imports.
 Discard Perk benefits were incorrectly applying in the Discard phase.
 Drag & Drop casting Actions during the Enemy turns is blocked. 
 Quick Casting an Ally Card with the Quick cast button, will now properly grant xp to the ally, reduce PC concentration (if the ally action is not effortless), substract the fatigue modified AP cost, remove reactions from the PC hand, and activate the cards in PC hand. If the player doesn't have enough AP to quick cast the card, they'll receive it in their hand.


 New Content 
 
 Added a couple new Enemies & Bosses
 Added a purchaseable player home in Misthold and 1 new Challenge for level 1-2 characters.
 Added 2x conflicting mid-level Challenges in Mirai & 1x in Ravensburg Manor
 Added 18 new Cards.
 Added 17 new Allies. 

 New Dwarf Allies: They'll appear for Dwarf characters or in Settlements with Dwarf Population. 
 New Ulniir Allies: They'll appear for Ulniir characters or in Settlements with Ulniir Population

 Added 2 new backgrounds and their assorted cards: Socialite, Cattle Rancher


 Misc Changes & QoL Additions 

 In Town UI: Added two buttons to open your Collection & the Equipment view in your Collection (if you want to inspect equipped items).
 In Town UI: Separated the 'Trade Commodities' button to Buy & Sell commodities. (Can now buy multiple Commodities). 
 Commodities will no longer show up in the "Sell Actions" section.
 Updated to the latest Unity Engine 2021.1.24f
 Commodities will no longer show up in the "Buy & Sell Consumables" section.
 If you use a Consumable from your Collection that opens an Event or Card Pick dialog, while the Town UI is open, the Town UI will be automatically hidden.
 Added a banter over the PC portrait as reminder, whenever the player attempts to cast a spell while the Enemies act.
 Dynamic area rewards can include a subset of preset rewards, that can be specified in the Rewards field. ie. "Area_7_Rewards": ["Fergus"], will replace one of the random rewards with the 'Fergus' card.


 Balance Changes (In favor of the PC) 

 Increased the amount of energy gained per hour of rest. It should be slightly easier to reach the Well Rested status even if the rest is interrupted by a random encounter.
 Added a minimum time threshold between the Overworld Encounters. This should prevent getting too many encounters in a row even if the player gets really unlucky with their encounter chance rolls while moving in the Overworld Map.
 Tweaked the Alchemy Actions.
 Tweaked the Seduction Actions.
 Tweaked Actions with Weaken to make them more viable as a defensive tactic.
 Tweaked a bit the perks that boost the Weaken, Destroy, Control & Pride effects (These Perk changes won't affect characters that already have these perks).
 Improved the scaling of the following effects per CL (Card Level).

 HarmAllies will stay the same / CL instead of +1 / CL.
 Weaken will increase by +2 / CL instead of +1 / CL.
 (most) Destroy effects will increase by +3 / CL instead of +2 / CL.
 (most) Control effects will increase by +2 / CL instead of +1 / CL.
 Pride will increase by +2 / CL instead of +1 / CL.



 Balance Changes (In favor of the AI) 

 Enemy 'Healing' tactic will also remove 'Weaken' counters from the target (based on the Tactic level). The complete Healing rule changed to: "Healed enemies restore a portion of their Health and remove a small amount of Bleeding, Venom and Weaken stacks (relative to the Healing tactic rank). While enemies have Healing counters, they are unable to use the Healing Tactic themselves and can only be further healed by an Ally."
 Enemy 'Regenerate' tactic will also remove 'Weaken', 'Bleeding' & 'Venom' counters from the target (based on the Tactic level). The complete Regenerate rule changed to: "As long as the Regenerate effect is active, Enemy will restore a small portion of HP every round and lose a small amount of Bleeding, Venom and Weaken stacks (relative to the Regenerate tactic rank)."

notes.title: The first World Map expansion is now live!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

If you are hanging out in our Discord server today's news, won't be much of a news for you. Neither if you are in the Development or Experimental Branches. As you've been seen this update cooking in real time. For everyone else, today's patch along with the usual QoL and bugfixes also expands (significantly) the World Map. 

You can visually see the map expansion in the image below. The dark areas being what you have, and the areas around what you'll get with this patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40271242/89317e9f775d66675790cd6798b40284560ef41d.jpg

While this is an 'infastructure' update, in the sense that now that new map areas exist they can be fleshed out more with future updates, dlcs and mods, add more minor locations etc, the update already adds 7 new towns, 22 new repeatable quests and a couple high level challenges to enjoy right now.

Most importantly, there is an improved algorithm in place for handing 'location mod conflicts', which in simple terms will allow our modders to expand all game locations by merging their content with the vanilla content, without worrying much about overwriting the vanilla locations.

You can check out the patch notes below for more details.

Have fun and let me know if you encounter any issues! 

Also make sure to have a pretty good deck before going against this guy:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40271242/1f70c9b709b4134ed8a4e6c9f27ed28c7461f630.png

 06/10 # 1.022.5 

 Bugfixes 

 Areas over 26 level weren't offering level-appropriate rewards.
 Fixed a couple of typos and definition errors.
 Brown Bear was missing the 'Companion' type. (Fix will apply in new Summonings)
 Fixed an issue with Mods overwriting vanilla Game Modes not working properly. (i.e Mods created via the ModifyGM command.)
 Damage preview algorithm was predicting a much higher damage in Fury + Vulnerable cards (than the Damage the card could actually deal).
 Perks benefits that would increase the random targets of Debuffs wasn't displaying on the Cards boosted (but was resolving correctly).
 Perk benefits that would increase or decrease certain bonus effect values wasn't displaying on the Cards modified (but was resolving correctly).
 Dispel effect tooltip description in certain cases could display a value less than card itself.


 New Content 

 Expanded the World Map with new hotspots for major & minor locations
 Added hotspots for the following Major locations: Arboris, Mirai, Glenfield, Fort Harrow, Llanvale, Misthold & Albruk
 Added towns and 22 Repeatable areas for various levels in all 7 new locations (4x in Albruk and 3x in each other). 
 Added 3 new high level Challenges in Fort Harrow, Llanvale & Clockmaker's Manor.
 Added Imports/Exports in the new Locations
 Updated the Journal covers affected by the world map expansion.


 Misc changes 

 Added a tooltip with the search filters in Players Handbook/Enemy Compendium.
 'Unmentorable' status will also appear under the special tags in Codex entries.
 Shift+S (Shuffle shortcut) will be disabled if Win key is also pressed, as shuffle could trigger while using the windows snipping tool.
 Chaotic Destroy & Chaotic Befriend will not pick the same target twice. Additionally the log will display which targets were picked and how many HP each had.
 If you are holding a card while pressing 'Space' to end your turn or before certain phases occur ie. Discard, Unravel etc, the card will automatically return to your hand before the phase logic runs.
 'Multiply' intent will display as 'Multiply then Attack'.
 'Regenerate' intent will display as 'Regenerate then Attack'.
 While the PC is traveling in the Overworld map towards their destination, map panning will be temporarily blocked for the duration of the movement.
 Changed the Ally 'Quick Special' button to: 

 "Target the first, or the enemy marked as your preferred target, and use your Ally ability card on them (without crafting it). You can still right-click your Ally to craft their card instead."
 If the ally has a choice of cards, instead of just one, you still get to craft it.
 If you are out of combat, you still get to craft it.

 Completing Conquest will now give both the 'Explorer' & 'Adventurer' achievements. This will apply to games completed after this change and can't be retroactive.
 Completing Campaign will now give both the 'Explorer', 'Adventurer' & 'Hero of Legends' achievements. This will apply to games completed after this change and can't be retroactive.


 Changes related to the Custom Artwork Cache 

These changes will only affect mods that rely heavily on graphics:


 Custom Artworks cache will persist while the game is running and won't clear up at each ModManager reset to prevent memory release / allocation issues in slower ram setups.
 Added a button to purge the Custom Artwork cache (If you disable any artwork mod you'll need to click this button before resetting the ModManager)
 Added a checkbox in ModManager to completely disable the Custom Artwork cache. This will load all mod graphics on demand, won't make for a smooth experience, but will save you RAM if you use too many artwork mods and your RAM has a slow speed.


 Modding Additions/Improvements

Modders can change the various Vanilla stage graphics with their own by placing their artworks (rec. 1920x1080) in Mods/ModName/CustomArtworks/Tales


 These files must correspond to a vanilla graphic set prepended with Set[Vanilla Stage].png ie. "SetJungle River.png"
 Vanilla Stages have the following names: Arid Hills, Cherry Blossoms, Coastal, Cultist Lair, Devil's Keep, Eerie Clearing, Forgotten Ruins, Frozen Mesa, Gambling Parlor, Ghost Ship, High Garden, Icy Mountains, Infernal Gate, Jungle River, Lush Forest, Marsh, Mistwood Overlook, Moonstone Mines, Old Ruins, Old Temple, Scorched Fields, Shipwreck, Smuggler's Den, Submerged Temple, Treacherous Dunes, Valley Overlook, Witch Hut, Witch Lair.
 You can alternatively override all game stages (or those you didn't provide a special graphic for) with a single graphic by providing a "SetUniversal.png"


Improved the code handling Location conflicts.


 Conflicting Location Mods are now merged with the vanilla content and with each other, instead of entirely overwriting each other.
 This means in practice that your location .json file can contain only the ID field ie. "ID": "Albruk" and only the info that you want to add or overwrite from the vanilla location. ie. Let's say that the vanilla Albruk contains definitions for areas 1-5. 
 Mod 1 could decide to simply change area 1 and add Goblins as a secondary population. And Mod 2 to add areas 6-10.
 All our three .json files will now get smashed together, and the end result will be the vanilla Albruk with a modded area 1, the rest of vanilla areas intact and the several new areas added by Mod 2.
 When overwriting an area it's important to overwrite all of its fields. i.e if you you overwrite area 1, but omit the description field, then the vanilla one could be used instead causing unintended results.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 02/10 # 1.021.9
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Aside from the various bugfixes, QoL additions and community requests, this patch also adds new challenges, places to claim as homes, and teleportation stones to travel quickly between them.

Unfortunately a bunch of graphic resources had to repack as they got optimized, and so the large update size, otherwise the size gain from the new resources is minor.

 02/10 # 1.021.9 

 Bugfixes 

 Fixed several typos and definition errors.
 Demon & Cambion were missing their 'Wicked' tag. (Fix will apply to new characters)
 Picking a custom portrait through "My Portraits" button, wasn't updating the PC gender.
 Fixed an error in the mimic encounter.
 Ethereal Blade Expertise req. changed to Illusions.
 Hexproof vest & Cultist background weren't giving their expertise bonus.


 Misc Changes & QoL Additions 

 Afterimage & Weave actions will stop processing if their optimal target is an 'Enemy' but their only legal target is the PC.
 Enforcer Bracers are now Activable.
 Optimized Events/Worldmap covers (which means their archive has to be rebuild from scratch and is why this update is so large in size)
 Triggering an 'Event' through a Card directly from the Collection, will now auto-hide the Collection window once the card triggers. ie. Lantern of Enlightenment.
 Blocked right-click casting of cards that must be used 'Out of Combat' while enemies are present and of cards that must be used 'Out of Challenge' while in a Challenge. This won't prevent you from using them in a different way other than right-click or to right-click them when their conditions are met.
 Blocked using 'Out of Challenge' cards from the collection while inside a Challenge. The popup dialog will show up a reminder you are in a challenge and have the confirm button disabled.
 Codex Entries (Alt+Click), will now include a section with special tags associated with a card ie. if it's excluded from the loot tables or if its exclusive to certain archetypes etc.
 New Game Mode setting: XPGainMultiplierUncapped:x (float), will multiply the XP gain by x after all the caps have been enforced.


 New Content 

 Forest Lodge: 1x challenge and a new player home to claim.
 Vanburg: 2x challenges chain for low-mid level characters and village.
 Vanburg Keep: 2x challenge chain for mid-high level characters
 Ravensburg Manor: a new purchasable player home for aspiring nobles. Can evolve to settlement.
 Teleportation system: 

 Teleportation Stones are single use commodities, that can be used outside of combat to instantly teleport the player in one of the properties they own. Exiting from the 'Teleportation Stone' event without using the stone, will let you to loot it back.
 Note to Modders: You can use this functionality using the Event reward "TeleportTo:Location" ie. # Grant:Rewards # TeleportTo:Oggurnvald Keep

notes.title: Patch Notes - 28/9 # 1.021.5
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Aside from the usual bug fixes, today's patch also adds several QoL additions, a more streamlined 'Activities' menu for the overworld map, Legendary chests in Level 16+ Challenges and various improvements in the 'Backpack' functionality.

You can read more details in the patch notes below.

 28/9 # 1.021.5 

 Bugfixes 

 Fixed an issue in Gauntlet mode that could count a Boss death twice and advance the player +2 stages instead of +1.
 Fixed an issue with Expertise Perk bonus not applying in certain cases i.e Compound Attack's strain bonus if the PC is Duelist.
 Fixed the World clock counting the Sunset as 'Night'.
 Fixed a World clock visual glitch always displaying 2 AM in the very first node after reloading a savefile.
 Fixed Vulnerable icon not displaying in the Player status icons area.
 Fixed Concealment from Shadow Shift not displaying in the Player status icons area.
 Fixed certain ally abilities from incorrectly displaying Expertise perk benefits. ie. Tutelary. (When allies come into play their 'Bonus Effect' abilities don't belong in any expertise.)
 Damage preview algorithm will correctly take into account the possible interactions between Concealment & Shadow Shift when projecting the Sneak Attack Damage.
 Fixed several typos and definition errors.


 Misc Changes 

 Leylines will reset after completing an Area.
 Compact View setting is saved and will persist across sessions.
 Elite allies are automatically Protected.
 Changed the Expertise Tier filter from eTier to exReq, as proximity matches were messing up the Tier filter.
 All Level 16+ Challenges have a chance to drop a Mythical Treasure (contains up to 4 Legendary items and you can pick 1) and/or a Lantern of Enlightenment (Allows to draft 5 cards).
 Changed the 'Complete 18 Challenges' reward from 'Sturdy Chest' to 'Mythical Treasure'.
 In Chests: Renamed the 'Review Collection' button to just 'Collection'. Added a second button 'Inventory', that also lets the player review their Inventory before picking a card.
 Added a filter in Deckbuilder that allows viewing Equipment cards. 

 Cards in this view are part of the Inventory and can't be filtered.
 You can Equip & Unequip items in this view using the +/- buttons.
 While the Deckbuilder is open this view can be accessed quickly with the 'E' key.

 Backpack will now operate in two distinct modes:

 Out of Combat → You can use your single-use consumable cards directly from your Collection as if they were in your hand.
 Once/Combat Turn → Look at 4 random consumable or trinket cards you own outside your Deck. You may pay 1 AP/card to Draw it.

 In the overworld map, you can access your Backpack faster from the Camp menu options or with its shortcut Shift+B.
 Streamlined the old 'Set Camp' option into a new 'Outdoor Activities' menu. It will be faster gathering resources and crafting as it's no longer needed to set up a camp in order to do these activities. But aside from AP these activities will also now increase the PCs tiredness levels.
 Exhaust:x, can be used as an event reward to increase player's tiredness by +x hours.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 24/9 # 1.021.3
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

This patch fixes the latest reported issues, so you can fully enjoy the game in the weekend. 

It also have certain warnings in place to help you counter the elusive "Blank Menu" bug. Which is caused if the core content gets deactivated for any reason. ie. through the mod manager by accidental clicking to deactivate it or steam didn't update the app correctly etc.

Aside from these bugfixes, there are a couple QoL additions and adjustments based on your feedback.

At this point, I hope that the game is stable enough to start working on larger content patches. 

So unless something is truly game-breaking, like the blank menu bug above, most builds will be heading to the Experimental and Dev branches (both are public branches you can opt-in), and will be updating the main branch every week or every two weeks with larger patches.

24/9 # 1.021.3 

 Bugfixes 

 This patch should be fixing the 'Blank' menu issue reported by a couple of players.
 Localization will persist across the session.
 Added a warning system if the Core Content gets accidentally deactivated. If it does, reactivate it & restart your mod manager.
 Perk related fixes (will apply in new games or before you get the relevant perks)

 Abduct III perk will give its benefit in Control 'Enemy' instead of 'Living'.
 Secrets of Blood II will correctly reduce the amount of Blood Surge expended.
 Fervent Faith 'Destroy Heretic' will properly apply only to Religion Actions.
 Characters starting the game with a 0 Summon Limit couldn't increase it further with Perks.
 Fixed a few typos.

 Conjurer wasn't properly counting as wicked.
 Cripple effect wasn't taking advantage of Vulnerable stacks


 Gauntlet bugfixes and changes 

 The clock wasn't updating while in Towns, allowing to shop indefinitely.
 Player's wealth wasn't refreshing after transactions.
 Ironman mode is back!
 Along with the Boss rewards Quest ascension chain will now give extra mastery upon completing them Quest (+10), Heroic Quest (+20), Epic Quest (+30), Legendary Quest (+40), Demigod Quest (+50)


 Misc Changes 

 Plague will now Control (any) 'Enemy' instead of 'Living'. 
 Increased the amount of the cards that are offered for sale per refresh.
 In camp: You can use Alchemy to craft up to Tier 2 recipes while Camping. You'll still need a Lab for more complex ones.
 Updated the entry for Hex Ward to make it clearer: "Next time you would suffer Bleeding, Feeblemind, Envenomed, Burning or Frostbite damage from these statuses, instead you prevent x points of that Damage. i.e. A stack of Venom x3 deal to you 9 Damage (3 Damage per counter). If you have Hex Ward 6, you can prevent 6 of that Damage. Hex Ward doesn't prevent you from getting these Statuses and neither removes them, but it prevents them from harming you, or mitigate part of their effects as they trigger (during your 'End of Turn' phase).
 Added a warning in the 'Sunken Caves' of Tethyar that is an underwater area: "Special: Non-Aquatic characters suffer Frostbite 5 each time they visit a new Node."
 Normally Enemies you kill (& unlocked their codex) are saved when you hit the 'quit' or the 'restart' buttons. They'll now also get saved each time you use a manual save slot, in case you want to close the app with window 'x' or alt+f4 after without using the "Quit" button.
 The card picking interface ie. Chests, Settlement stores etc. now have a button that lets you review your collection. If this is during an 'event' all shortcuts are locked, so you can close the Collection dialog with its 'x' or 'close' buttons.
 Since you can use Consumables from your Collection anyway if you are out of combat. Backpack rule changed to: "Look at 4 random consumable or trinket cards you own outside your Deck. You may pay 1 AP/card to Draw it while in Combat. Or Draw it for free out of Combat."
 Perks will display their level requirements in their description too, as it was an easy requirement to miss.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 23/9 # 1.021.2
notes.content:
Hi folks!

I hope you are enjoying the game! 

This patch fixes the latest reported issues, along with a couple more things.

 22/9 # 1.021.2 

 Bugfixes 

 While previewing a card at max level their 'Reaction' icon wasn't showing up in their title.
 Doom & Contract spawns could cause allies to temporarily pass the summoning limit.
 Enemy preview while holding the arrow over an enemy was displaying 'vulnerability' as 'estimated damage', when a card didn't had any damage source.
 Improved the code handling Immunity removal while the player has a certain buff (ie QuestStateBewitchedAffectsUndeadWhileDefend:true) and fixed certain cases it wasn't working properly. Additionally it's no longer required to declare the buff you will use in the ModLoaderUser.conf file.
 Controlled Skeleton & Ghoul enemies (with the Control Archetype effect) where coming into player's control counting as 'Living'
 When using cards directly from your collection, it will now take into account that the card might be part of your deck or in your hand.
 Adjusted the Use card confirmation Dialog to the left, to prevent it from appearing outside the screen when a card is far to the right.
 Marwen the Undying will now properly drop 'Tebitha's Inert Staff', which let you loot the 'Tebitha's Staff of Supreme Power'.
 All characters with the 'Nobility' expertise will properly count as 'Noble'.
 Perk gains will properly apply on 'Bonus Effects' too.
 Fixed a bug in 'The Witchcraft Ritual' event.
 Fixed some typos in a couple of cards.
 FixedFreeze, FixedBewitch & FixedStun effects optimal/right-click target is now properly set to 'Enemy'.


 Misc Changes 

 Split cards, that display two damage sources, will also include the split keyword and the explanation: 'Card base DMG is split between two elements. It still counts as one DMG source.', as it could be confusing how they interact with vulnerable counters. (Vulnerable applies once)
 During the Discard phase any left-over Equipment cards will be discarded first.


 Modding Additions 

 You can use a custom icon for your custom expertise or to overwrite the vanilla ones. 
 You need to place an Expertise[Expertise Name].png file in CustomArtworks/Actions
 i.e. ExpertiseArtificer.png, ExpertiseWitchcraft.png etc.
 If a custom Expertise icon exists will display as the PH category icon over the archetype icon.
 Moved the HP,AP & XP bar above the character artwork. And the character artwork a bit to the right. It won't have any significant impact or benefit on the vanilla artworks, but if you are using portraits without transparency, then it will no longer fall over them or appear off-center.

notes.title: Important Hotfix - 21/9 # 1.020.9a
notes.content:
Hi folks,

It's really important to update to this build, as yesterday's patch introduced a bug in the Blood Tribute code. We all know that patches introduce 10 new bugs for the one they fix. But this is that important to guarantee an immediate hotfix, as it can propagate to various game systems. 

I think all the issues caused by it will be resolved, but will keep investigating in case I missed something.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 20/9 # 1.020.9
notes.content:
Hi folks!

This build also focuses on fixing the various bugs and typos you reported on Steam and on Discord, along with adding some of the QoL additions you requested. 

20/9 # 1.020.9

 Bugfixes 


 Perks that where removing immunities, wasn't working if the enemy counted as [species] but didn't have that exact [species]. ie. Control Undead wouldn't work on Skeletons or Vampires, as their type is Skeleton & Vampire but also count as Undead.
 'Ally Undead' & 'Ally Demon' ripple effects should no longer trigger when creating Allies through Doom or Contract effect, only when the ally card is played.
 Marsh Naga was missing their Aquatic tag. (Fix will apply on fresh Naga characters).
 Fixed an issue with updating and deleting decks that were partial matches of each other (ie. a deck name that was containing the other deck name in it)
 Expertise effects in the form of ModifyEffect[Ally Stat][Element]IfExpert[Expertise] will now work properly ie. the Elemental Servant bonuses.
 Card's like Balam's Blessing weren't properly updating the 'Contract' effect Summon.
 One with Nature card could be acquired in Stores, even if it's Perk exclusive.
 Cards with Blood tribute like Quick Slash that stop processing after attempting to target the PC, will no longer display the banter that you picked the wrong target. Unless of course it is cast manual on the PC.
 Fixed an exploit/bug in perk preview that could transfer perks to other classes.
 Allies should no longer play hide and seek behind their friends.
 Fixed the reported typos.


 Use consumables in the Overworld 


 You can now use certain consumables directly from your Collection/Deckbuilder.
 As long as you are 'Out of Combat', you can use "Self" & "Single Use" Consumables directly from your Collection (even on the overworld map). As if you cast them from your hand. 
 If a card can be used it's backpack button will be interactable.
 A dialog will ask you to confirm, but other than that is up to you to decide if playing such a card from your Collection has any merit or not.
 (Let me know if you encounter any weird issues using this feature.)


 Improved Deck Validator 


 Deck validator will now tell you if you attempt to start the game with an insufficient collection and give you the breakdown of your Actions, Consumables & Equipment.
 Hovering over your Starting Collection will give you a breakdown of how many Actions, Equipment & Consumables it consists.


 Misc Changes 


 Coven Rule is under revision. For now its change is: Empower gained from Coven won't wane, as if the Card also had Empower.
 Improved the Algorithm generating the Collector boosters.
 Tokens & Mastery earned from Challenges are now capped at 20 instead of 10.
 Leaving a Town and starting a new Zone will now auto-save the progress.
 Increased the amount of healing received when resting in Town inns (65/65) and reduced the cost to 45f. Additionally the clock will advance to the next morning.
 Slightly nerfed the Skeleton Guard.
 Removed the +1 Summon Limit bonus from Conjuration & Necromancy Ritual perks. That will only affect new characters.
 The LP & PP gain per level rule will now display in the detailed mode rules.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 18/9 # 1.020.8
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Thank you all for picking up Erannorth Chronicles and I hope you are enjoying the game. 

I am looking forward to hear your thoughts, read your reviews (even if they are negative) and improve the game further. 

Today's patch should be fixing all the bugs you reported and a couple more I noticed watching a stream, if I missed any kindly let me know. It also adds a couple of QoL additions into the mix.

For those who want to dabble into modding, the first guide is up, so if you want to create your own custom backgrounds, starting gear kits, and even sub-archetypes you can. It's really easy.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2603938530

Finally for those who don't like the Full Artworks in the Arcana and Allies, you can turn them off, by subscribing to this mod:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2604437250

If you have any questions or come across anything that doesn't seem right let me know. It's better to investigate something and turns it's not bug, than let one alive to ruin your experience. ;)

Have fun guys! And thanks for being part in this journey, as I mentioned before it's just starting...

18/9 # 1.020.8

 Bugfixes 

 While dragging Enemies to re-arrange them, passing them over an ally could cause the ally info to stay open.
 Loot cards will now mention that you can loot up to x cards, instead of x. ie. Secret of Blood I.
 The active buffs/status icons on the left of the PC avatar wasn't (visually) refreshing before playing an action.
 The 3 Adventure cards produced by the Adventurer's Journal now have the 'Out of Challenge' requirement, as using them within a Challenge could bork their Achievements.
 Cards like Ghosts of Remorse that should add multiple cards in the drawpile was adding just the first instance of this effect.
 Silversmith card will now properly add 1x Silver Coating & 2x Silver Bombs in the Draw pile.
 Fixed several typos.
 Fixed a definition mistake in a couple of Aeromancer, Hydromancer & Pyromancer specific items.
 Afterimage effects wasn't visually displayed on allies/permanent's Demise effects. ie. Explosive Keg
 Draining Allies with cards such as Absorb Essence would work properly but the log would display that it didn't.
 Town Tiers weren't properly affected by the player's local influence. 


 Misc Changes 

 Night Covenant, Aradia's Gospel & Incantation to Aradia perks will also increase the Summon Limit of Witches by +1. This won't apply retroactively in savefiles i.e if your Witches already have these perks.
 Changed Silver Coating uses to 1, Removed Singleton.


 QoL Additions / Community Requests 

 Aside from 'X' your Journal can also close with the 'Esc' key. As a reminder this is the only event that can be closed without reaching the 'exit' choice.
 Changed the icon for Hex Ward as it was similar/could be confused with the Resist Physical icon.
 Resist Physical, Supernatural & Elemental will now mention in their tooltip the particular resistances they apply to.
 Cards that give XP to the next card, or mentor, will now mention in their tooltip that this is a synergy and won't apply on cards that ignore them.
 Added a tooltip in the card element. Will display the element in text, and clarify that the number underneath is the AP cost. 
 Element is now also clickable and will display the card's codex entry.
 In Kill effect tooltip added: "The Enemy level 'Kill' affects scales up with your level."


 Modding Additions

 New Keyword OutOfChallenge:1, If you are in the middle of a Challenge such actions will fail.
 New Ripple Effects type "Ally Species"

 You trigger a ripple effect if your summoned ally is of a certain species.
 This ripple effect will trigger as you summon the ally.
 ie. QuestStateRippleEffectAlly Bovine:StrengthenAlliesOfTypeBovine#2, Whenever you play a Bovine ally, Bovine Allies get +2 Power.
